_audio_doc: Audio entries carry a single 'audio' file (AAC/.m4a), written by utilities/build_web_audio.py. js/src/assets.js resolves them the same way it resolves images, and falls back to the source WAV when one is missing.
_doc: Web-sized copies of assets/game/, written by utilities/build_web_assets.py. js/src/assets.js reads this to pick a size; a path missing here falls back to the PNG, so the browser build runs from a plain checkout either way. Do not edit by hand -- re-run the script.
